title: Chart and KPI Definitions
summary: Defines exact formulas, bucket logic, event taxonomy, and scoring heuristics used by dashboard visuals.
coverage: Data quality dependencies and staleness effects

sections.title: Calculation windows and limits
paragraphs: Dashboard calculations use fixed windows so week-to-week comparison stays honest. Findings trends are weekly buckets (4, 12, or 26 weeks). Recent activity uses 30 days. Stale coverage uses 90 days since last completed test.
Coverage gaps, apps needing attention, tester workload, and recent activity paginate in place so every row stays reachable.

rows: `26` stored, sliced to 4 / 12 / 26 on both charts
`10` rows per page, up to `50` events
`3` rows per page; never-tested first, then stale
`5` assigned testers per page. Unassigned is a KPI, not a row.

sections.title: KPI formulas
paragraphs: Open-risk KPIs come from `pentest_findings` (drafts excluded). Coverage KPIs come from pentest rows on each host. Closed vs opened uses the last five weekly buckets, which covers a little over 30 days.

rows: count of findings whose status is not `draft` and not closed (`fixed`, `accepted`, `not_affected`)
Shown as the Open findings hint.
pentest status is not `In Progress` or `Completed`
Includes hosts with no pentest row.
status is `Completed` and `test_end_date` is older than 90 days (or missing)
sum of weekly `opened` / `closed` over the last 5 buckets
Closed vs opened strip uses these.

sections.title: Trend series definitions
paragraphs: The Dashboard chart pair shares one 4w / 12w / 6m control. The upper chart is weekly flow (opened vs closed, with net in the hover). The lower chart is currently active stock (`openStock`) at the end of each week. Hover a week to read counts. Tooltips on the last three points open to the left of the cursor so values stay on-screen.

Weekly buckets start on Monday UTC. `opened` counts findings created in the week. `closed` counts findings whose status became closed in the week (`updated_at` while status is `fixed`, `accepted`, or `not_affected`). `openStock` is how many were still open at the end of that week.

rows: created on or before week end, and not closed on or before week end

sections.title: Recent activity event definitions
paragraphs: Recent activity consolidates finding filings, pentest lifecycle events, and inventory scope updates. Timestamps render as relative age when recent.
Click a row to open the application, finding, or host when the viewer has Security or Assets permission.

rows: status completed with `test_end_date` in last 30 days.
record status is `updated` with recent modification timestamp.
record status is `missing` with recent modification timestamp.

sections.title: Attention and workload sorting
paragraphs: Apps needing attention sort by open finding count, then by untested in-scope hosts. Workload rows are assigned testers only, sorted by open findings, then in-progress volume. Unassigned stays on the KPI strip.
These heuristics stay simple so managers can validate prioritization without an opaque score.

rows: Descending `openFindings`, then `inProgress`, then `total`. Unassigned is omitted.
CVSS bands: critical `>=9`, high `>=7`, medium `>=4`, low `>=0.1`, else unscored. Open findings only.
